notes.title: Update v1.10.086 is online.
notes.content: Journey of a Roach is out on Linux! With the help of our community we were able to do a portation that should work on most distributions. Besides this we did some small fixes and added an option to switch off auto recognition of gamepads for all of you who ran into problems with this feature. See [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/255300/discussions/0/648812917596081553/]this[/url] post for the changelog.

notes.title: Update v1.10.086 is online.
notes.content:
Journey of a Roach is out on Linux! With the help of our community we were able to do a portation that should work on most distributions.

Besides this we did some small fixes and added an option to switch off auto recognition of gamepads for all of you who ran into problems with this feature.

See [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/255300/discussions/0/648812917596081553/]this[/url] post for the changelog.

notes.title: Update v1.10.046 is online.
notes.content: We added a new configuration launcher for the game. It should now work properly when mapping unsupported input devices with the separate configuration application. Just select 'Configuration Dialog' when starting Journey of a Roach to open it. See [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/255300/discussions/0/648812917596081553/]this[/url] post for a full changelog.
